title: Puppet Stagehand Website and Documentation Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan for a static Astro Stagehand site with data contracts, OpenTofu AWS environments, and GitHub Actions deployment.
notes: Path is docs/superpowers/plans/ (no adr/prd/spec directory signal). Content is dominated by implementation contracts: explicit interface lists, JSON Schemas, TypeScript types, HCL variable validation, cache-control rules, and named enums. Also carries binding 'Global Constraints' (static-only, no analytics, evidence-bearing compatibility claims, mandatory tags, exact environment names) which read as technical constraints rather than user-facing requirements. No Decision/Consequences sections and no status field, so not an ADR; no user stories or acceptance criteria, so not a PRD. Classified SPEC over DOC because it defines contracts the system must honor. Task/step checkbox structure is execution scaffolding, not a separate type.
